_note: The fixed display gamut of the LS021B7DD02 panel: RGB222, i.e. 4 levels (0,85,170,255) per channel = 64 colors. These are the swatches the web builder offers as the default ('device palette') colour picker; the native OS picker stays available for off-gamut custom colours (the device quantizes those at render time). Order matches obc-sim's --palette screen (8 columns, 2x2 of 4x4 red blocks). Edit this file to curate the quick-pick set; it is the colour-picker analogue of the factory config.json.
